sections.text:
This
document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on a monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title block.

The burner fuel oil boosters P/Ps 
(3 per unit)
have capacity of 908 L/mint at a discharge press. of 83 Kg/Cm2 and 115C each
under normal operation two P/Ps are in service the discharge press. of the P/Ps
is controlled by pressure control V/V that recirculates
the oil back to the suction of the burner fuel oil heaters

The first draft initiated by eng.
Ali El-Safoury, tested by eng. Mohamed Anwar Ghazy, accepted by general director 
eng. Gamal Abd El-Meguid El-Safoury, and approved by eng. Mohamed El-Tahawy: head sector of Shoubra El-Khimah PS.

تم تنقيح هذه الوثيقة بواسطة المهندس. Nageh Soliman Shousha: 
 CEPC quality control director, and certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim 
 El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's Head Sector and MPIS coordinator.

Work order must be issued and the
maintenance staff should the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear the safety and healthy 
equipment as safety helmet, shoes, earplugs etc.

Isolate the circuit breaker of 
the fan motor.

Disconnect electric terminals 
of fan motor.

يجب عزل المروحة 
ميكانيكيا عن طريق إغلاق المثبط التسليم

Check 
the bearing temperature, change oil if needed or repair and change the bearing 
if needed.

Check for excessive vibration 
and make alignment if needed (Normal 4.8 mm/s)

Listen for unusual noise 
,check the bearing and change it if needed.

Check mech. seal for leakage 
and change the mechanical seal in case of leakage.

Check the P/P for capacity and discharge press, repair any of the internal parts 
or change if needed.
Check the inlet and outlet pipes and repair if needed.
